en.title: Jasper or Copy.ai: which one for a marketing team?
en.metaTitle: Jasper vs Copy.ai (2026): prices, agents, credits, who it fits
en.description: Jasper and Copy.ai compared on price, agents, workflow credits, hosting and real limits. Plain facts checked in August 2026, plus who should pick which.
en.intro: Jasper is a marketing content platform sold per seat, with brand voice, a canvas and marketing agents. Copy.ai is a go-to-market workflow platform sold per workspace, with a cheap chat tier and expensive workflow tiers. The deciding question is whether you buy a writing tool for a few people or a workflow engine for a whole sales and marketing org.
glance: Who it is for
Marketing teams that write a lot and want on-brand output
Sales and marketing ops teams that run repeatable content and outreach workflows
What you get
Chat, Canvas editor, images, marketing agents, brand voice, custom agent builder (Business)
Chat with OpenAI, Anthropic and Gemini models; workflows on paid tiers; API on Enterprise
Price
Pro $69 per seat monthly or $59 annual; Business custom
Chat $29 per month ($24 annual) for 5 seats; Growth $1,000, Expansion $2,000, Scale $3,000 per month; Enterprise custom
Free plan or trial
7-day free trial on Pro
No free plan shown on the pricing page at check
EU hosting
No. Data hosted in US data centres (US-East)
Not published. SOC 2 report available
Team features
Brand voices, knowledge assets, audiences; admin controls and groups on Business
Seat bundles per tier (5 to 200); designated support team on Enterprise
Build your own agents
No-code custom agent builder on Business only
Workflow builder on Growth and up; unlimited custom workflows on Enterprise
What is metered
Chat and Canvas are not metered; agents and GEO Hub use credits on Business
Workflow credits: 20K, 45K, 75K per month on Growth, Expansion, Scale

pickA.heading: Pick Jasper if…
points: You have two to ten marketers who write daily and want one brand voice enforced across all of them.
You want a per-seat price you can start on a card today. Pro is $69 a month with a 7-day trial.
You want images, a long-form editor and marketing agents in one place rather than a workflow builder.

pickB.heading: Pick Copy.ai if…
points: You run the same content or outreach process hundreds of times a month and want it as a workflow, not a chat.
You need 75 or more seats. Growth at $1,000 a month covers 75 seats, which is cheaper per head than Jasper Pro.
You only need a cheap multi-model chat for a small team. Chat is $29 a month for five seats.

a: Business pricing is not public, and the custom agent builder, GEO, deep research and API all sit there. Budgeting means a sales call.
Trust gap between review sites: 4.7/5 on G2 but 3.4/5 on Trustpilot, where billing and cancellation complaints and the 2023 price rise for existing customers still come up.
b: The jump from Chat ($29) to Growth ($1,000) is large. There is no mid-price plan for a team of ten that wants workflows.
Reviewers name workflow credits and support as the main pain. Trustpilot sits at 1.9/5 with billing and cancellation complaints and email-only support that can take days.

en.verdict: Jasper wins for a small marketing team that writes on-brand content every day and wants a simple seat price. Copy.ai wins for a large go-to-market org that wants content and outreach as repeatable workflows and can pay four figures a month. Neither offers EU hosting today.

bridge.heading: If you want the work done, not a chat window
bridge.text: Both tools above give a person a place to prompt or a workflow to build. If the team's real need is a competitor report, a campaign plan or the Monday performance PDF, that is a different product: a coworker you brief, a board the team sees, a file at the end. Sokosumi is a marketplace of named AI coworkers for marketing teams. Each has a role, a public profile, sample work and a named vendor that states its models and hosting.
points: You brief in plain language or @mention in a channel; the task shows on a shared board and ends with a finished file.
Credits only when a task runs. Free: 250 credits per seat per month, no card. Paid seats €25, €75 or €200 per month.
EU hosting available, stated per coworker. Built by Serviceplan Group with NMKR, Munich.

faq: Does Jasper have a free plan?
No. Jasper Pro has a 7-day free trial. After that it is $69 per seat monthly or $59 per seat on an annual plan.
Workflow credits are the meter for running workflows. Growth includes 20,000 a month, Expansion 45,000 and Scale 75,000. Chat use is unlimited and does not use credits.
Can either tool host data in the EU?
Jasper states its data is hosted in US data centres. Copy.ai does not publish a hosting region on its security page. Ask sales and get it in writing if EU hosting matters to you.
Is there a third option that delivers finished files?

Yes. Sokosumi is a marketplace of AI coworkers that return finished files such as reports, decks and spreadsheets to a shared board. It has a free tier of 250 credits per seat per month and EU hosting stated per coworker.
